subject: Next steps + procurement contacts for BlueHarbor pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@blueharborhealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps + procurement contacts for BlueHarbor pilot

Hi Sofia / Tom —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot lined up: 

- Scope: 2-week internal pilot focused on discharge-summary generation for three hospital units (approx. 3k tokens/day).
- Success criteria: latency < 400ms p50 and < $0.0008/token cost after batching; accuracy check on 200 prompts that match your sample set.
- Resources: Laura (CC) will own onboarding/config during the pilot and run the kickoff technical session.

Action items I have from our call: 
1) Please confirm procurement path: who owns vendor onboarding and PO issuance (name + email).
2) Any security or legal checklist we should expect (SOC2, DPA, custom clauses)?
3) Target timeline — you mentioned late Aug for a pilot start; can you confirm dates and any blackout windows?

If you can loop in the procurement contact, I can send the vendor packet (W9, bank details, standard MSA + SOW) and a short vendor questionnaire.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Sofia to introduce procurement/legal (if not already) — by EOD Tue 7/21.
- Laura and I to schedule a 60-min technical kickoff once procurement confirms timeline.

Attachment: RBW_W9.pdf (we'll include our W9 upfront to speed PO setup).

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
viv@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0189

[Attachment: RBW_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@blueharborhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps + procurement contacts for BlueHarbor pilot

Vivek —

Thanks for the summary and for sending the W9. Quick answers below: 

- Procurement lead: Elena Morales (elena.morales@blueharborhealth.com) — she owns vendor onboarding and PO issuance.
- Legal lead: Rajiv Patel (rajiv.patel@blueharborhealth.com) — will cover the DPA/MSA review.
- Security: We will require a current SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) and the standard data-processing addendum — I expect legal will request the SOC link.
- Timeline: We are aiming for a pilot start the week of Aug 31 — internal approvals by Aug 15 would be ideal. We have a budget renewal window the week prior, so timely PO submission matters.

I'll introduce Elena + Rajiv on the next message.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Director of Clinical Innovation | BlueHarbor Health
sofia.ramos@blueharborhealth.com | (617) 555-1234

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharborhealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@blueharborhealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@blueharborhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps + procurement contacts for BlueHarbor pilot

Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks for taking this on. Per Sofia, BlueHarbor would like to target an Aug 31 pilot start with approvals by Aug 15. To accelerate, I can provide the following in one packet: W9, MSA (redwood standard), bank wiring details, SOC 2 report link, and a short vendor onboarding questionnaire. 

Quick questions from procurement/finance perspective so we can prepare the right docs: 
- Do you require Redwood to register as a vendor in a specific portal? If so, what's the URL and a point-of-contact?
- PO cadence: one-time PO for pilot + larger PO for production, or will you use a single long-form PO?
- Invoicing: electronic invoice to AR@blueharborhealth.com? Net terms? Any specific invoice fields (PO number on invoice)?
- Banking: do you require EFT/wire only or do you accept ACH?

Laura (CC) will run the technical kickoff once procurement confirms timeline. Marissa is supporting contract coordination and will help with the DocuSign flow.

I'll attach the onboarding questionnaire and our bank/W9 so Elena has what she needs to start vendor setup.

Cheers,
Vivek

[Attachment: BlueHarbor-Vendor-Onboarding-Questionnaire.docx]

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@blueharborhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@blueharborhealth.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@blueharborhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 13:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps + procurement contacts for BlueHarbor pilot

Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the packet. A few items to note for vendor setup at BlueHarbor: 

- Please complete the attached Vendor Onboarding Questionnaire and return to vendors@blueharborhealth.com.
- Required docs to start: completed questionnaire, W9, copy of government ID for authorized signer (we accept passport/driver's license PDF), and bank wiring details (account + routing).
- Registration: Submit vendor packet via our portal: https://vendor.blueharborhealth.com/register (we will create a vendor ID within 3 business days of complete submission).
- PO & invoicing: Invoices must reference the PO number (we'll issue a PO once the vendor is approved). Send invoices to AR@blueharborhealth.com; payment terms Net 30 from invoice date. We pay via ACH; wire instructions are accepted for expedited payments but require a completed bank-verification form.
- Legal: Rajiv will route MSA edits; we typically accept small, non-substantive redlines but will need to review any indemnity/data residency changes.

Attachment: BlueHarbor-Vendor-Onboarding-Questionnaire.docx

If you can submit everything this week, we can aim to have vendor ID and PO ready by Aug 12, which aligns with Sofia's timeline.

Elena Morales
Procurement Manager | BlueHarbor Health
elena.morales@blueharborhealth.com | (617) 555-9876

[Attachment: BlueHarbor-Vendor-Onboarding-Questionnaire.docx (docx)]
